meta.title: Improve Clojure join compilation
meta.body_summary: Optimize Clojure compiler by translating simple left/right/outer joins to direct comprehensions and regenerate outer_join without _query helper, updating docs and test fixtures.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex generated a compiler optimization removing query helper for joins; no review or evidence, instantly self-merged by author tamnd.
